subject: social_science

concepts.title: Cabinet Decision Making
concepts.definition: The process where a group of senior ministers makes major policy decisions collectively in the name of the Council of Ministers.
concepts.key_idea: Collective responsibility of the inner ring of ministers for government policy.
question_patterns: calculate the total size of the council if cabinet has ... and state ministers are ...
find the total number of ministers given ... cabinet and ... state ministers
how many ministers are there in total if cabinet is ... and state is ...
determine the sum of cabinet and state ministers for a council of ...
compute the total ministerial strength given ... cabinet members and ... state ministers

solution_steps.action: add cabinet members to state ministers
solution_steps.explain: The council of ministers is the sum of its different ranks.

concepts.title: Parliamentary Budget Delay
concepts.definition: The period during which the Rajya Sabha can hold up a money bill passed by the Lok Sabha before it must be returned.
concepts.key_idea: Lok Sabha holds supreme power in money matters, limiting Rajya Sabha to a 14-day delay.
question_patterns: calculate the maximum days Rajya Sabha can delay a money bill
how many days can the upper house hold a budget bill
find the limit in days for Rajya Sabha to suggest changes
what is the maximum duration for delaying money bills
determine the constitutional limit for delaying money legislation

solution_steps.explain: The constitution restricts the Rajya Sabha's power to delay money bills to 14 days.

concepts.title: Ministerial Tenure
concepts.definition: The time limit within which a non-member appointed as a minister must get elected to either House of Parliament.
concepts.key_idea: Ministers must secure democratic legitimacy through election within six months.
question_patterns: calculate the months a non-MP minister has to get elected
how many months are allowed for a minister to join parliament
find the time limit in months for election of a minister
what is the grace period in months for a non-member minister
determine the deadline in months for ministerial election

solution_steps.explain: A minister who is not a member of parliament must be elected within six months.
